blocks.text: For many Filipinos, financial needs rarely arrive one at a time. A household may be managing monthly bills when an unexpected expense comes up, while a small business owner may need extra capital to restock or keep operations moving. Having a bank account or e-wallet makes it easier to move money, but it does not always mean the right financial support is available when it is needed. With 58% of Filipino adults now owning a formal financial account, the next challenge for financial inclusion goes beyond access and into the actual usage of services to save and borrow securely.
